a2dp_sink.title: [Accept Stereo Audio (A2DP) Playback From This Device]
a2dp_sink.desc: This feature allows your PC to act as a wireless Bluetooth speaker receiving audio from this phone or tablet.

peripheral.no_tweak: This tweak does not apply to this device.
peripheral.desc: This device is a Bluetooth peripheral ({type}) and does not support stereo audio (A2DP) or headset features.

common.title: [Common settings for all devices]
common.avrcp_checkbox: Control legacy apps with AVRCP buttons
common.avrcp_desc: Routes headphone playback buttons (Play, Pause, Next, Prev, Stop) through system transport proxy so legacy desktop media players (foobar2000, VLC, MPC-HC) respond.

messages.saved: Settings saved successfully to registry for {mac}.
messages.admin_needed: Administrator privileges are required to save changes to Windows registry.
